snippet.title: 👻Priest Simulator: Her Ghost DLC (Release Trailer)
snippet.description:
👻Her Ghost arrives in San de Ville on December 5th, 2024 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2947900/Priest_Simulator_Her_Ghost_DLC/

The Tooth Fairy’s up to no good in San de Ville, and only Orlok (with a little help from Cardinal Godspeed) can clean up the mess. Three new exorcisms, ridiculous cutscenes, and dialogue so awkward it could host a talk show.

Think of it as satire, chaos, and maybe even a little catharsis—all wrapped up in one unholy package.

#PriestSimulator #HerGhostDLC #ToothFairyTrouble #MockumentaryGaming #IndieGames
